incident.title: ZeroDivisionError in shipping rate calculation for digital orders
incident.description: When users purchase digital-only products (such as eBooks or virtual gift cards) with zero shipping weight, the checkout fails with HTTP 500. The stack trace shows a ZeroDivisionError in the shipping rate calculation function.
incident.error_log:
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File 'app/services/shipping_service.py', line 14, in calculate_shipping_rate
    cost_per_kg = 15.0 / weight_kg
ZeroDivisionError: float division by zero
incident.expected_behavior: Zero-weight digital items should incur $0 weight charge without throwing ZeroDivisionError
incident.recent_changes: Commit 4b92c1: Updated variable parcel shipping tariff calculations

"""
Unit tests for shipping rate calculation service.
"""

import pytest
from app.services.shipping_service import calculate_shipping_rate


def test_standard_shipping():
    res = calculate_shipping_rate(weight_kg=2.0, distance_km=50.0)
    assert res["total_shipping"] > 0


def test_digital_items_zero_weight_shipping():
    # Should not raise ZeroDivisionError for zero-weight digital orders
    res = calculate_shipping_rate(weight_kg=0.0, distance_km=10.0)
    assert res["weight_charge"] == 0.

     if distance_km < 0:
